result.summary: The screen is generally functional with a few minor visual imperfections.

issues.description: Top-right profile button displays an empty circle with an offset red notification dot.
issues.suggestion: Add a user avatar or icon inside the circle and align the notification badge properly.

issues.description: Subtext inside the green promo banner has low contrast against the background.
issues.suggestion: Increase the lightness or opacity of the subtitle text to improve readability.
